caption:
Stock market news | Sensex and Nifty end week lower after rally fizzles out

Indian stock markets ended the week in the red as a midweek recovery rally fizzled out. The market dropped after a two-day rally snapped due to profit booking on 27 November 2026.

The decline wiped out gains made during the midweek recovery. Both major indices, the Sensex and Nifty, faced pressure from profit booking towards the close of the week.
